_comment: Hand-picked case-study gallery frames. `top` is the scroll offset in the 1440px-wide full-page capture; `note` becomes the visible caption. Offsets were chosen from .taste-skill/contact/*.jpg contact sheets. Regions where a live site currently has a broken or unloaded asset are skipped on purpose — the gallery shows only what actually renders.
